# Zosia Jorvley

Zosia Jorvley is currently a Drone Operations Specialist at Umbaly Cloud, where she focuses on executing precise aerial surveys for construction site topography. Since joining Umbaly Cloud in late 2021, Zosia has played a critical role in integrating drone survey data with the company’s autonomous rebar tying systems, helping to enhance site mapping accuracy and streamline robotic deployment.

Prior to Umbaly Cloud, from 2017 to 2021, Zosia managed the drone fleet for Skylark Infrastructure’s large-scale urban redevelopment projects. There, she led the “SkyMap Initiative,” developing optimized flight patterns that reduced survey times by 30% while improving 3D mapping resolution. She also contributed to the “EagleEye Program,” which combined drone data with AI analytics to monitor site safety hazards in real-time.

Zosia specializes in coordinating drone flight operations under challenging conditions, ensuring comprehensive data capture with minimal site disruption. She is known for a methodical working style that emphasizes meticulous flight planning and cross-disciplinary collaboration. At Umbaly Cloud, Zosia works closely with the robotics engineering team, site surveyors, and safety officers to align aerial insights with on-the-ground construction workflows.

Current employer: [[companies/umbaly-cloud]].
